name: bookmarks-lifecycle
description: A local MCP server that gives saved bookmarks a lifecycle with time-based layers (pending, watching, kept, lapsed), so they get decided on instead of accumulating. It aggregates bookmarks from your browsers, drips them into a daily queue, and supports keep/watch/drop decisions, restore, and undo.
